integrity: All infinite-time statements are derived analytically from invariant-measure generator identities and a bounded-complete-orbit representation of y. The zero-activity equality case is proved by support collapse and invariance. No finite simulation is used as a substitute for proof. The printed vector field, equilibrium, primary MSC classification, publication date, and the scopes of the closest same-system papers were checked against primary-source material.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove existence of a periodic or chaotic attractor at any parameter. The strict interval requires \(a>0\). The exact statistic is a y-weighted mean height, not the ordinary mean of z. An unindexed prior statement of the same identity remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact activity–height law for the Wang–Chen perturbed Sprott-E flow
